archetypes.name: dyn-title-filter
archetypes.rationale: Checks normalized bug-title selection behavior and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the analyze-bugs title filter changes. Confirm lifecycle prefixes are stripped only from the beginning, the bug marker match is case-insensitive, and mid-title mentions of [BUG] are still excluded. Check that tests cover the intended fixed-bug and terminal-report cases without broadening selection unexpectedly. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
